in_arabic.name: Fikraat
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fikraat هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'fikr', meaning 'thought' or 'idea'. It represents the process of contemplation and reflection, leading to wisdom and knowledge.
